value.title: Bounded attribute cursors preserve every eligible full original and exact order
value.statement: Read only existing eligible RTree candidate IDs, deduplicated in original order, through attributes-only cursors of at most32 rows. On API28+ a separate explicit1MiB geometry window contains at most32 whole BLOBs<=16KiB (512KiB payload); API26/27, large originals and safely unsupported drivers retain full PFD reads. This is not a total RAM bound; SQLite sorters plus one Java full buffer/decoded original remain. SQL CASE typeof/length avoids large/TEXT payload materialization without truncation; exact ID/order/length/cardinality checks reject incomplete or reordered originals. One lazy compiled BLOB statement belongs to one visit, never a global/thread-shared cache. Preserve all typed fields/NULLs/geometry, hidden/excluded masks, source epochs, current/owner/content/style guards, free-only policy and existing style/clip/labels/PBF. Cancel/error closes both cursors/descriptor/statement; current is rechecked between queries. Mid-window capability fallback never repeats delivered IDs; cleanup and real SQL/resource errors remain failures and a bad/missing BLOB cannot become successful partial PBF/cache. Default Access fixtures and public original editor/sync APIs remain compatible. No all-layer features list, global GeoJSON cache, thinning or simplification. Existing phase boundaries stay comparable, with geometry query/prefill/refill in BLOB_READ and inline/PFD counts counting consumed full buffers rather than physical prefetched IO. Native readiness, PSS and sharp17to12/new-extent speed require actual tablet evidence.
